verdict.rationale: Codegen is primarily an autonomous coding agent (writes code, fixes bugs, reviews PRs, runs security/test-coverage scans) rather than a data-analytics or insights product; PR review summaries and security scans (codegen-docs-20) show some 'insight generation' but not general data-driven insights/suggestions from a user's own data. missing for 10: evidence of analyzing arbitrary user datasets/business data and surfacing proactive insights or dashboards, independent corroboration of insight quality, and any UI-embedded analytics/suggestion feature beyond code-related tasks.
